links.comparator_used: Base GPT-4 and GPT-4o without guideline PDF context (training knowledge alone); prompt-only contextualization also tested
links.outcome: Agreement with NCCN guideline-preferred therapies and rate of guideline non-concordant therapy recommendations for NSCLC
links.effect: Agreement 23/24 for PDF+Prompt vs 17/24 for GPT-4 (P = 0.040) and 18/24 for GPT-4o (P = 0.089). Non-concordant therapies: 0 for PDF+Prompt vs 4/12 for GPT-4 (P = 0.093) and 5/12 for GPT-4o (P = 0.037). Prompting alone did not significantly improve agreement or reduce non-concordant recommendations. PDF+Prompt responses had lower word count and lower SMOG and Gunning Fog scores.
links.quote: The PDF+Prompt contextualized model demonstrated elevated agreement scores of 23/24 versus 17/24 for GPT-4 (P = 0.040) and 18/24 for GPT-4o (P = 0.089).

design_hint: retrieval grounding with guideline PDF and prompt contextualization
